with_context:
57% of new supervisors got under 8 hours of formal training.

That number is from our Plant Leaders Survey: 412 plant leaders, fielded this June. Getting new supervisors ready fast is one of the 5 problems you tell us about most, along with hiring operators and unplanned downtime.

So our Q4 webinar series is about exactly that. 3 sessions, October to December, each with a guest plant manager.

The first one is October 22.

How many hours of training did you get before your first shift as a supervisor?

#Manufacturing #Operations #Supervisors

Draft for Morgan's approval. Sources: 57%, 8 hours and 412 from the Plant Leaders Survey 2026 (research library); the 5 problems from "What our audience struggles with". First comment: the registration link, which is not in the Brain yet. Also not in the Brain: the October 22 guest's name and the start time, so I left them out instead of guessing. Post it Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday at 8:30 AM Eastern.

differences.what: It is about getting new supervisors ready; the first post never learns the topic
It opens with a sourced number, in 11 words
Plain and calm: no exclamation marks, no hype words
It speaks to plant leaders and ends with a question they can answer
The link goes in the first comment, with 3 hashtags
It comes back as a draft for Morgan, with its sources
It leaves out the guest and the time instead of inventing them
